verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe built-in Agentforce agents in Sales Cloud. They are said to autonomously handle repetitive tasks around the clock, can be turned on across every deal stage, and perform tasks such as qualifying inbound leads, updating opportunities and closing renewals, with admin access controls over what agents can see. This shows a native AI assistant that users can hand work to, though the support is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how a user delegates tasks to the assistant (conversational/assistant UX, scope of actions), independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works in practice.
